native_boundary.native_body: Original qualified full SAGE body, depth2/width128, existing all-map factorization and route/dropout conventions; native source/graph unchanged.
native_boundary.H: Exact live tensor passed to the original native output_linear, after the existing output_normalization; shape [M,N,D] for shared bank or [1,N,D] for one body.
native_boundary.Z: Same forward native logits; full node order, class order unchanged.
native_boundary.dtype: native float32; projected values, means, centered quantiles and residuals float32
native_boundary.feature_normalization: No new H L2 normalization, feature/node standardization, graph/batch/running normalization or fitted scaling. Retain only native normalization; directions normalized below; quantiles centered by their own neighbor mean; log-degree unscaled.
native_boundary.capture: Existing adapter/native head prehook; live in TRAIN, removed in finally; no detached cache, extra native forward or selector-dependent hidden boundary.

support.include: Every factual record with source != target; directed incoming support; no symmetrization
support.duplicates: Every duplicate record retained with full multiplicity for mean/order-statistic population and gradients
support.self: Exclude all factual self records; add no identity record; native backbone graph untouched
support.degree: Count incoming nonself records, including duplicates; prepared once without labels
support.ordering: Within each target use original factual record order; stable projected-value sort preserves that order at ties
support.full_neighborhoods: No degree cap, sampling, subsampling, truncation or dropped high-degree row. A degree-bucket implementation is permitted only if algebraically identical.
support.empty: All descriptor values zero; no phantom/padded observation enters an aggregate.

directions.candidate_and_moment: U_raw[4,D], one learned private direction per live native route
directions.common_direction_control: U_raw[1,D], one learned direction used with each different H_m; private V_m remain; signatures are not asserted equal
directions.all_signature_M1_and_each_I4_copy: U_raw[4,D], four learned directions applied to the one body H; four signatures, one corrected class vector
directions.forward: u = U_raw / norm(U_raw, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8); a=H dot u
directions.initialization: CPU float32 standard-normal torch.randn using a fresh local CPU Generator per direction; fixed draw only, no search or global/native/dropout RNG advancement
directions.optimization: Raw vectors are ordinary trainable parameters; differentiate normalization; no orthogonalization, retraction, direction penalty or gradient rerouting.

quartiles.mean: FP32 arithmetic population mean over the d incoming scalar records
quartiles.interpolation: For d>0 and each q: r=(d-1)*q, l=floor(r), h=ceil(r); Q_q=(1-(r-l))*sorted_a[l]+(r-l)*sorted_a[h]. If l=h both refer to the same order value.
quartiles.center: Three Q_q minus the same population mean
quartiles.layout: [centered Q_.25, centered Q_.50, centered Q_.75, log1p(d)]
quartiles.d_one: three centered quantiles exactly zero; degree field log(2)
quartiles.ties: Stable original-record order is the specified subgradient choice. Autograd through gathered/interpolated sorted values; no averaging of tie gradients beyond ordinary duplicate-source accumulation. No differentiability guarantee at tied/crossing order values.

moment_control.layout: [mean, stabilized population std, min, max, log1p(d)]
moment_control.population_variance: mean((a - mean(a))**2), divisor d, never d-1; compute centered squares in float32
moment_control.empty: all five descriptor fields exactly zero
moment_control.constant_or_d_one_nonempty: mean=min=max=a; stabilized std=1e-4; degree field log1p(d)
moment_control.epsilon_provenance: Fixed PNA-style positive stabilizer, explicitly declared adaptation; no epsilon search; not an unbiased/sample standard deviation.
moment_control.PNA_boundary: Matched scalar-projection statistic-rich adapter, not a complete PNA layer or faithful full author-model reproduction.

residuals.candidate: Private V[4,4,C]; route m adds t_m @ V[m]; all entries zero; no added bias
residuals.moment: Private V[4,5,C]; same zero initialization/no bias
residuals.common_direction: Private V[4,4,C], same zero initialization/no bias

all_signature_M1_and_I4.input: concat(H, centered Q for direction0 then1 then2 then3, one log1p(d)); dimension D+13
all_signature_M1_and_I4.head: Linear(D+13,128,bias=True) -> ReLU -> Linear(128,C,bias=True)
all_signature_M1_and_I4.first_layer_initialization: Unchanged standard torch.nn.Linear reset_parameters convention inside isolated CPU RNG scope
all_signature_M1_and_I4.result: One residual [N,C], added to unchanged native Z; one corrected class vector per native body, not four pseudo-members.
all_signature_M1_and_I4.isolate_limit: The nonlinear H-input head can alter isolate logits after fitting; it is intentionally a richer capable control. Only zero-start native identity is shared with the candidate.

training.loss: mean over actual native members of (.5 CE(Z[:,TRAIN], y_TRAIN) + .5 CE(S[:,TRAIN], y_TRAIN)); M1/I4-copy each actual-member count1
training.gradients: Every H, direction normalization, scalar source gather, mean, sort/interpolation, residual parameter and native body/factor path live; no detach/custom gradient/cross-route state average
training.zero_start: Scores equal native; initial native-gradient coefficient1. Direction/descriptor/native correction-path derivatives are initially zero through zero residual output; do not demand initial nonzero direction gradients or call a tiny VJP utility evidence.
training.labels: Only original complete TRAIN targets in CE. No human/pseudo label value, TRAIN anchors, teacher or reconstruction targets enter descriptors.
training.optimizer: Original-law AdamW lr .001, betas(.9,.999), eps1e-8, weight_decay0; all native/factor/residual/direction parameters registered before optimizer, exactly once; no new parameter-specific group or multiplier
training.native_training_opportunity: Width128/depth2/dropout.2; at most1000 updates, patience300, original native/factor/dropout seed conventions. Root fixes execution source/gates before qualification/fits.

selection_and_restore.joint_shared_banks: Strict whole corrected probability-mean VALID accuracy improvement; earliest ties; original patience
selection_and_restore.genuine_I4: Each body separately trained, separately optimized and selected by its own corrected VALID accuracy; no pool selector during acquisition
selection_and_restore.restore: Strict complete model state including residuals/directions, optimizer and member RNG streams; no rebuild/redraw after selected state restore
selection_and_restore.readouts: Archive native Z and corrected S/member probabilities separately from the same corrected-selected checkpoint; uncalibrated native and corrected probability means authoritative. Native contrasts include selection/stopping.
selection_and_restore.calibration: Secondary only; policy in CALIBRATION_POLICY.json; no model/selector/objective change.

arms.native_routes: one per separately fitted body, four pooled at serving
arms.residual: four separately fitted all-signature nonlinear residuals
arms.role: root-strengthened capable independent ensemble; each body richer than one candidate route

representative_roster.graph: full encountered WikiCS native roles; TRAIN580/VALID5274; TEST closed
representative_roster.genuine_I4_strengthening: Supersedes predecessor narrow one-direction I4. Same observed graph/features/labels, four learned signatures and nonlinear H-input residual per body versus one scalar direction/linear residual per candidate route. Information/readout capacity and sorting work deliberately richer; no equal-parameter/equal-operation claim.
representative_roster.plain_references: Closed native ordinary/factorized single/I4/shared archives as contextual references; no sixth fresh arm added.

ancestry.FSW: 2504.02544v1 selected §2.2–3/A.1: projected distributions, quantile functions, Fourier embedding and graph cardinality/isolates; candidate direct quartiles are not FSW and inherit no injectivity/Wasserstein guarantee.
